name: dishwasher-thermador
grounded_in: Read 2026-08-19. §14 Cleaning and maintenance: 'Check the filters for residues after each dishwashing cycle' + 14.2 Cleaning spray arms. Troubleshooting E:20-60 says to descale a calcified heating element. §9 is the rinse aid system; the manual also covers detergent, water softening and Home Connect pairing. NOTE: this is a modern QR-code manual — the actual steps live behind QR codes, so the document is unusually thin on procedure.
notes: The appliance class that started the curation work ('Add Detergent Before Each Cycle' as a task). It also tests restraint: with the real steps hidden behind QR codes, a parser that writes confident detailed instructions is inventing them.

must_have.why: NEVER DROP category, and the manual gives it its own numbered section.
Named section 14.2; a functional part, so 'clean' here must not be read as cosmetic cleaning.

should_have.why: The manual only reaches it through an error code, so missing it is forgivable — but it is a NEVER DROP category.

must_not_have.why: THE canonical bad task. Constantly repeated, and still just running a dishwasher.
Dialling a setting is a preference, not maintenance.

One-time config / personalisation. NOTE: `app` is word-boundaried because the unbounded form matched inside 'Appliance' and flagged 'Descale the Appliance' — an expectation that fails on the right answer is worse than no expectation.
